text:
Based on the onboarding guide, Hermes Agent supports outbound media and file dispatch to platforms like Telegram using **`MEDIA:<path>`** tags.

To forward an image or media file produced by an MCP tool to Telegram:
1. Save or provide the generated image to a local file path.
2. Output or reference the file using the format `MEDIA:<path>` (e.g., `MEDIA:/path/to/logo.png`), which Hermes Agent will recognize and dispatch natively as Telegram media.
